semiconductor_relevance: High — VERMES Microdispensing specializes in advanced dispensing solutions critical for semiconductor packaging processes.
summary: VERMES Microdispensing provides cutting-edge non-contact dispensing technology tailored for semiconductor applications, focusing on high precision and speed. Their solutions enhance coating quality and production efficiency, addressing the challenges posed by miniaturization in semiconductor packaging.
capabilities: Non-contact dispensing technology for droplets as small as 0.4 nl
Real-time visualization and monitoring of dispensing processes
Compatibility with a wide range of materials including conductive and insulating substances

regional_presence.Japan: Alpha Electronics, the Japanese distributor of VERMES, plays a key role in delivering their solutions in the region.
